features.title: Daring duelist
features.text: Your style turns a favored skill into a combat tool, from athletic maneuvers to social tricks. Build for precision damage, defense or helping allies create openings.

features.title: Panache and finishers
features.text: Build panache through bravado actions, then decide when to spend it on a finisher. Remaster rules make gaining panache more forgiving, but action order still matters.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4 → 3.5–4.5. Finishers enable strong precision damage; style and feat selections influence the routine.
ratings.defense: 3.5 → 3.5–4.5. Defensive reactions and dueling choices can prioritize avoiding damage.
ratings.support: 3 → 2.5–4.5. Gymnast maneuvers and social-skill styles support very different team roles.
ratings.utility: 2.5 → 2.5–3.5. Style skills provide strong specialties without the rogue's breadth.
ratings.difficulty: 3 → 3. Panache is more forgiving in the Remaster, but finisher timing and setup still matter.
